concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

logic_text: any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5

concepts.label: Explanation of Material Discrepancies
concepts.definition: Requirement for passport applicants to explain material discrepancies between application names and supporting evidence names.
concepts.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

context_quotes: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

concepts.label: Documenting Material Discrepancies
concepts.definition: Documentation requirements and acceptable documents for establishing a material name change.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

alternative_quotes: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
choice_text: One or more of: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); certificates of naturalization; marriage certificates; documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or documentation of customary usage.
logic_text: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
action: document by submission of one or more listed documents

summary: Material discrepancies between the application name, evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or identity evidence must be documented by submission of one or more listed documents (court orders/decrees including name change orders or divorce decrees, naturalization certificates, marriage certificates, documentation of name change by operation of state law, or customary usage documentation), subject to the married names exception in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

concepts.label: Review of Name Change Evidence
concepts.definition: Review of submitted evidence of material name changes to detect counterfeiting or alteration.
concepts.quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

context_quotes: NOTE: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

concepts.label: Prohibition on Using Previous Name
concepts.definition: Restriction against continuing to use a prior name after undergoing a material name change unless expressly permitted by documentation.
concepts.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

scope_text: After a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
logic_text: may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
summary: The applicant must not continue to use a previous name after a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits continuing to use that name.
quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

concepts.label: Identity Evidence Requirement Possibility
concepts.definition: Descriptive possibility that evidence of identity might be required under regulation to establish applicant identity.
concepts.quote: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

context_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

concepts.label: Application Suspension for ID Update
concepts.definition: Adjudicator requirement to suspend an application and request an updated ID when a material name change occurred more than one year prior without an ID update.
concepts.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Limited-Validity Passport Issuance
concepts.definition: Permission to issue a limited-validity passport in the requested name when urgent travel prevents obtaining acceptable updated ID.
concepts.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name

concepts.label: Notation of Name Change Documentation
concepts.definition: Mandatory notation on name change documents prior to returning them with an information request letter.
concepts.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)

concepts.label: ID Submission Exemption
concepts.definition: Exemption from submitting updated ID in the new name for applicants who changed names within one year of applying on Form DS-11.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.
